description.text: Two years study in Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunication, another two years in British Queen Mary College.

duration.text: The E-commerce engineering with law at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 9722 USD/per year ￥ 70000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. High school academic transcript 4. High school graduate certificate 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.The Transcripts of mathematics, physics, chemistry 7.Health certificate

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 to 30 years old; 2. A good command of English 3. Analogous to graduating from senior High school in China, with good marks 4. Additional explanation: Applicants, who do not meet the above requirements, may be considered on an individual basis. They may be admitted as non-degree seeking students for one academic year. Those who pass the examinations held one year later will be automatically accepted as regular students. Those who fail will return to their home country as graduate students after completing some courses in a program.
